# My Voyager layout. `make` turns this into keymap.c; see README.md.

# Colours: a short name for the lights grids, then QMK HSV (hue, saturation,
# value, each 0-255) or a #hex. The comment is the name ZSA's Oryx gives it.
color cadmium    =  41 255 255   # Cadmium Yellow #FFF500
color devil      = 139 198 148   # Devil Blue #217794
color harlequin  =  74 218 204   # Harlequin Green #4CCC1D
color magenta    = 221 218 204   # Mystifying Magenta #CC1DB2
color mitchell   = 139 232 159   # Mitchell Blue #0E7B9F
color moss       =  41 220 148   # Turtle Moss #949114
color queen      = 203 218 204   # Prom Queen #9E1DCC
color seaweed    = 109 236 209   # Seaweed #0FD17A
color starship   =  41 199 224   # Starship #E0DA31
color structural = 139 241 210   # Structural Blue #0BA0D2
color tangerine  =  24 231 213   # Tangerine Haze #D58314
color violet     = 208 156 143   # Dull Violet #82378F

layer main
  tab>numbers q   w     l     r      f             y        u      i     o     p  bspc
  esc         a   s+ctl d+alt t+gui  g             h        j+gui  k+alt e+ctl ;  '
  shift       z   x     c     v      b             n        m      ,     .     /  enter
  @mirror     ctl alt   gui   @lower _             _        @upper left  down  up right
                              spc    gui>numbers   bspc>vim enter

layer lower
  ~ ! @ # $ %   ^ &    * (    )    _
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ unds + {    }    |
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ _    _ _    _    _
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ _    _ vold volu _
          _ _   _ _
lights
  queen queen queen queen queen queen   . queen queen moss  moss  .
  .     .     .     .     .     .       . queen queen moss  moss  queen
  .     .     .     .     .     .       . .     .     .     .     .
  .     .     .     .     .     .       . .     .     queen queen .
                          .     .       . .

layer upper
  ` 1 2 3 4 5   6 7 8 9    0    _
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ - = [    ]    \
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ _ _ _    _    _
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ _ _ vold volu _
          _ _   _ _
lights
  . devil devil devil devil devil   devil devil devil devil devil .
  . .     .     .     .     .       .     devil devil devil devil devil
  . .     .     .     .     .       .     .     .     .     .     .
  . .     .     .     .     .       .     .     .     devil devil .
                      .     .       .     .

layer numbers
  _ H-c _ _ _ _   A-C-spc _ _ 7 8 9
  _ _   _ _ _ _   rgb_tog _ _ 4 5 6
  _ _   _ _ _ _   rgb_mod _ _ 1 2 3
  _ _   _ _ _ _   _       _ _ 0 . /
            _ _   _       _
lights
  . seaweed . . . .   seaweed . . mitchell mitchell mitchell
  . .       . . . .   cadmium . . mitchell mitchell mitchell
  . .       . . . .   cadmium . . mitchell mitchell mitchell
  . .       . . . .   .       . . mitchell mitchell mitchell
                . .   .       .

layer mirror
  _ p o i u y   _ _ _ _ _ _
  _ ; e k j h   _ _ _ _ _ _
  _ / . , m n   _ _ _ _ _ _
  _ _ _ _ _ _   _ _ _ _ _ _
          _ _   _ _
lights
  . queen queen queen queen queen   . . . . . .
  . queen queen queen queen queen   . . . . . .
  . queen queen queen queen queen   . . . . . .
  . .     .     .     .     .       . . . . . .
                      .     .       . .

layer vim
  _ _ _    up   C-u   S-v   0 b w    e   $ _
  _ _ left down right v     ^ h j    k   l %
  _ _ _    _    C-d   C-v   { } "gg" S-g _ _
  _ _ _    _    _     _     _ _ _    _   _ _
                _     _     _ _
lights
  . . .         harlequin tangerine starship   violet     violet     violet     violet     violet  .
  . . harlequin harlequin harlequin starship   violet     magenta    magenta    magenta    magenta violet
  . . .         .         tangerine starship   structural structural structural structural .       .
  . . .         .         .         .          .          .          .          .          .       .
                          .         .          .          .
